name: Build OpenAPI Contract
summary: Build an OpenAPI contract from verified behavior, reusable schemas, failures, and executable checks.
description: Build or repair an OpenAPI document by reconciling implementation, tests, product requirements, authentication, schemas, examples, and error behavior. Use when an HTTP API needs an accurate machine-readable contract or drift review.
risk_reason: This skill builds an OpenAPI contract from verified behavior, reusable schemas, failures, and executable checks; it does not invent endpoints, fields, examples, status codes, or security scopes.
refuses: It does not invent endpoints, fields, examples, status codes, or security scopes.
It does not expose internal or sensitive schemas merely because implementation fields exist.
It does not publish, deploy, or guarantee backward compatibility without evidence.

operational.latency_reason: The skill builds an OpenAPI contract from verified behavior, reusable schemas, failures, and executable checks, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
